turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Happy Friday. How is your morning going in Phoenix today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi! It's going well, thanks. Phoenix is already getting pretty warm! I actually just got to the clinic. The traffic was a bit heavy, but taking my hybrid car today made the drive a lot smoother.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Glad you made it safely! Did you manage to grab a warm drink to kickstart your shift before heading in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I made myself an iced whisked green tea with milk before leaving. It's my favorite way to get a bit of caffeine without coffee.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, that sounds delicious and refreshing. Did you listen to that true-crime podcast your coworker recommended during your drive?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually didn't today! Instead, I put on an audio program designed to practice vocabulary and phrases for my Italian studies. It really helped pass the time in traffic.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Che bello! That is a great way to squeeze in some study time. What do you have planned for lunch today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm actually meeting up with Tom in a little bit. We're getting a bite to eat together near my clinic.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: How lovely! It's always nice to break up the workday with a lunch date. Have you two had any more thoughts about the wedding plans for summer 2028?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A little bit! We are mostly just enjoying being engaged right now and looking at potential venues online, but we aren't rushing into anything too quickly.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a very stress-free way to handle it. Enjoying the engagement is so important. Do you have any sourdough baking planned for this weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I might feed my starter tonight and bake a loaf tomorrow morning! But for now, I should probably head in and start my shift. Talk to you later!
